summary: @omniwatch-wick/cli posts host identity to hardcoded worker endpoint
details: The package's bin/omniwatch.js imports child_process, os, http, and https, reads host identity (os.userInfo(), hostname, process.platform) and POSTs data to hardcoded endpoints https://agentpolice-api.vedantn06soni.workers.dev and https://night-watch-indol.vercel.app. The name and endpoints are consistent with a monitoring/agent-registration CLI whose documented purpose is to report host telemetry to the author's hosted backend, which is a legitimate architecture but relies on trusting the maintainer's gateway with host identifiers. There is no observed reading of installer credential paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser stores), no environment-variable scraping, no install-time lifecycle hook, and no fetch-and-execute of remote code. Whether the outbound host telemetry fires on install/require or only when the operator runs the CLI, and whether the endpoints are the maintainer's documented backend, warrants human review before publishing a verdict.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
